name: MIT Reality Mining (Mendeley processed)
citation: Khushnood Abbas (2018), Real Human Contact processed data, DOI10.17632/d6bzzfd23g.1; Eagle & Pentland (2006), DOI10.1007/s00779-005-0046-3
scan_coverage_evidence: Only positive dyadic edges; no empty scan/online logs. Third column observed as small integer ticks; scale not confirmed.
reason: missing verified scan support or insufficient eligible chronological samples; no reliable negative assumption; timestamp tick scale not verified; no conversion to seconds/days or24h labels
missing_data_policy: No recorded contact is not proof of a negative. No inferred labels or model scores.
duplicates_policy: Repeated source measurements retained; valid_pairs is distinct. No deduplication of repeated timestamps across different pairs.
preprocessing_note: Processed redistribution; repeated dyadic rows retained and diagnosed. Do not infer raw mobile scanner availability or assume third-column seconds.
